title: Porkchop merge decisions
description: Dedicated layouts for the decisions added by the Porkchop911 merge, which had no UI. Synthetic gallery fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Ground hit: sustain damage
shots.caption: An effect (Deorbit Barrage and similar) assigned a hit to a named ground force. The card shows the unit with its icon, and the planet with its system, and each answer says what it does: Sustain damage keeps the unit, damaged; Let it be destroyed removes it. Before, this was a bare 'use SUSTAIN DAMAGE' / decline list.

shots.heading: Crimson commander: gain or convert
shots.caption: After a combat the commander pays its holder. The card prints the commander (Ahk Siever) with its ability, shows the commodities and trade goods held, and each answer says what it does (commodities 1 → 2, or commodities 1 → 0 and trade goods 4 → 5). Before, two plain labels.

shots.heading: Deepwrought commander: gain or convert
shots.caption: The same layout for Aello, paid to the holder when another seat takes 1 off its research cost.

shots.heading: Deepwrought commander: reduce research
shots.caption: The researcher's side of the same card: the commander as printed, the research cost before and after (4 → 3) and what each answer does (Reduce the cost by 1 pays the holder; Pay in full pays nobody).

shots.heading: Research waiver: ignore prerequisites
shots.caption: A faction ability (Yin's commander, the Cabal's Riftmeld) lets a seat research a technology without its prerequisites. The card names the technology and says what the choice is; the engine's own label for each waiver is kept, capitalised.

shots.heading: Research waiver: choose the payment
shots.caption: The second step: the card names the technology and the waiver being paid for, and lists the legal payments. Declining researches nothing and pays nothing.

shots.heading: Hacan commander: spend trade goods for votes
shots.caption: After the planets, Gila the Silvertongue may turn trade goods into two votes each. Instead of a list of 'spend N' labels the panel shows the outcome voted for, the votes so far and the trade goods held, with a stepper; the button says what the chosen amount does (3 trade goods: 7 → 13 votes). Shown here after two clicks on +.

shots.heading: Construction: PDS or an alternative
shots.caption: After a PDS spot is picked, Titans' Hecatoncheires may replace the PDS with a mech and an infantry. The card names the planet and its system, 'Place the PDS' keeps the plan, and the alternative keeps the engine's own wording. This decision never reached the planet bar (its options carry no planet), so it had been a plain list.

shots.heading: Place units from your reinforcements
shots.caption: Abilities that place units (Mitosis, Yssaril, ...) used to offer 'place 2x infantry on jord in 14'. The card shows the unit, the most that can go and each spot by planet name and system with how many go there. The engine does not offer spots that cannot take the unit, so only legal spots appear.

shots.heading: Take a revealed action card
shots.caption: Mageon Implants and Spy Net show another seat's hand and let you take one card. Each shown card now appears with its printed text and phase, the way a hand-limit discard does, with a note and a 'Take card' confirm; before it was a list of names.

shots.heading: Titans: coexist or fight
shots.caption: Slumberstate Computing: where Coalescence would start a ground combat on another seat's planet, the Titans may coexist instead. The card prints the first sentence of the breakthrough, names the planet with its system and the seat that controls it, and says what each answer does.

shots.heading: Ssruu: choose a unit for the copied agent
shots.caption: When Yssaril's Ssruu copies a Letnev or Sol agent, the card prints the agent and each candidate unit appears by type and place with whose it is, in place of 'other_seat's cruiser (unit 1)'.

shots.heading: Ssruu copying I48S: replace which infantry
shots.caption: The options now carry their planet and system, so the question is answered on the planet bar and the map instead of from a list of labels.
